query: SELECT c.id FROM intake.conversation c JOIN intake.homeowner h ON h.id = c.homeowner_id WHERE ($3::uuid IS NULL OR h.contact_id = $3) AND (c.job_id = $1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM intake.intake_answer a WHERE a.conversation_id = c.id AND a.question_id LIKE 'job.%' AND a.choice = $2)) ORDER BY c.opened_at, c.id LIMIT 1
